description: A Java class defining a band-limited sawtooth oscillator (SawOscillatorDPW) that extends another oscillator class, including methods to set frequency and render waveform samples.

classes.name: SawOscillatorDPW
classes.description: A band-limited sawtooth oscillator implementing the DPW (Derivative of an Integration) method to reduce aliasing, with adjustable frequency and waveform rendering.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the oscillator's frequency and updates the scaler used for waveform amplitude based on frequency.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the next sample of the waveform, applying a quadratic transformation and differencing to produce a band-limited sawtooth wave.
